item.title: Global wildfires decreased during the COVID-19 lockdown, but some fires intensified without human intervention
item.description: When the COVID-19 pandemic brought human activity to a standstill around the world in the first half of 2020, wildfire incidents also declined by more than 12%. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.title: Almost 300,000 people now live in flood‑prone areas in the Nepalese Himalayas—new research
item.description: On Aug. 26, a rock and ice avalanche triggered a huge flood that swept through a steep valley in Nepal, leaving thousands dead and missing. It was an extreme example of a growing problem across the Himalayas. As glaciers melt, glacial lakes expand and mountain permafrost thaws, the risks from floods, landslides and other high-mountain hazards are increasing. At the same time, more people and infrastructure are moving into the valleys where these hazards are most likely to strike. Fuente: Phys.org.
